title: PASSING FAITH
TO THE FUTURE
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: open leather bible on rustic wooden table with soft lamplight
warm sun rays hitting a cozy home living room corner
dried olive branches in a ceramic vase near a window
peaceful rolling hills at golden hour from a porch
soft focus candle glowing beside an old wooden cross
gentle morning light on a quiet family dining table

scenes.a: If you are worried that your children will lose their way,
We will not hide them from their children, showing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
Lord, help us imprint Your glory upon their hearts so they walk in Your light always.

That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
Lord, help us imprint Your glory upon their hearts so they walk in Your light always. Amen.
